rule: argmax over the grid of TPR(informative |GT| >= tau) - FPR(follow |GT| >= tau); derived from GT + label only
what: nav-compliance tau for --graft-nav-compliance (PI E1 ruling 2026-09-26: all three selection mechanisms ON for refcv7)
evidence_class: MEASURED (thor6, Linux aarch64, CPU; GT poses + labels only, no model)
split: TRAIN: the 4,572 clips of the manifest below (the split the model trains on)

nav_from_v7_stats.derivation: v7.2 nav_command token (oracle, provenance ego-future; allow_oracle_nav=True)

heading_rule: compliance_target: last-segment heading of the GT waypoint path, 0.05 m stall

args.pos: |terminal heading| of GT paths on LEFT or RIGHT windows
args.neg: |terminal heading| of GT paths on FOLLOW windows

method.selection: argmax over the grid of TPR(pos >= tau) - FPR(neg >= tau)
